2014_spells.immovable-object.description: You touch an object that weighs no more than 10 pounds and cause it to become magically fixed in place. The object can hold up to 4,000 pounds of weight.
2014_spells.immovable-object.effectSumma: Change a target: touch an object that weighs no more than 10 pounds and cause it to become magically fixed in place
2014_spells.immovable-object.fullDescrip: Using 1 action, you touch an object that weighs no more than 10 pounds and cause it to become magically fixed in place. The object can hold up to 4,000 pounds of weight. The effect lasts for concentration, up to 1 minute.
